chief executive officer Eli Yaffe will retire from his position effective September 23, 2026.
Yaffe will remain CEO until the effective date to ensure an orderly transition.
In recognition of his extensive experience, the board has resolved to appoint Yaffe as a director of the company, effective March 8, 2027.
The board has named Ron Freund, Eltek’s current chief financial officer, as CEO, effective September 23. Freund will continue serving as CFO until the company appoints a successor to the position.

title: Eltek CEO Eli Yaffe to retire
